compiler_cardprogram_representations: typed target schemas and object predicates
continuations: target, APNAP, search, ordering, distribution, and cost choices
subsystem_capsules.current_debt: SelectionContinuation v1 is the shared immutable envelope for represented target, search, APNAP, Storm, legend, and Battle choices. Distinct operation owners preserve target, hidden-search, public-nontarget, and cost-selection contracts. Existing SemanticChoiceContinuation v2 remains the typed Game Record v3 handler payload for already-extracted semantic choice operations rather than being reinterpreted or duplicated. CommanderEngine retains high-level decision dispatch, domain-specific candidate calculation, and explicit historical continuation adapters.
subsystem_capsules.privacy_sensitivity: Hidden-zone candidates and private choice payloads must never cross principal projections.
subsystem_capsules.removal_condition: No missing-owner condition remains. Historical Game Record v3 adapters may be removed only after supported records no longer require their prior continuation shapes; future choices must use a typed contract and immutable operation payload without restoring engine-local begin/complete execution.
subsystem_capsules.replay_behavior: Choice actor, legal references, revision, source/stack identity, and completion are replay-critical.
subsystem_capsules.responsibility: Own targeting, nontarget public choices, hidden-zone searches, cost selections, ordering, distributions, and versioned continuations without conflating their rules contracts.

compiler_cardprogram_representations: semantic trigger nodes and runtime trigger components
continuations: APNAP trigger ordering and trigger target/mode placement
subsystem_capsules.current_debt: TriggerProcessingOwner owns delayed scheduling and matching, immutable occurrence materialization, typed Ward discovery, APNAP batching, ordering, and pending-target coordination. CommanderEngine retains narrow compatibility adapters and high-level stabilization calls; specialized combat, prevention, and zone producers remain separate typed event sources.
events_consumed: normalized zone, combat, damage, prevention, upkeep, and semantic events
events_produced: immutable trigger occurrences and ordinary stack items
subsystem_capsules.privacy_sensitivity: Trigger placement choices are seat scoped; public occurrence facts must not reveal hidden source data.
public_ports_and_protocols: normalized committed event to TriggerOccurrence pipeline
subsystem_capsules.removal_condition: No missing-owner condition remains. Future trigger work must migrate specialized producers through the normalized occurrence port without restoring runtime Oracle-text interpretation or moving decision authority out of the server-issued capability path.
subsystem_capsules.replay_behavior: Controller-at-trigger-time, LKI, occurrence identity, ordering, and pending batches are authoritative replay state.
subsystem_capsules.responsibility: Own normalized event subscription, immutable trigger occurrences, simultaneous collection, APNAP placement, target/mode selection, stack commitment, and pending batches.

continuations: mulligan, priority, cleanup, and yield decisions
subsystem_capsules.current_debt: TurnStepOwner owns normal and extra-turn selection, active-player and turn-start state, phase/step boundaries, cleanup iteration, and end-the-turn coordination. TurnPriorityDecisionOwner owns priority grants and passes, yield invalidation, meaningful-action opportunity journaling, and deterministic pumping. CapabilityManager remains the typed single-use decision credential owner. CommanderEngine retains narrow compatibility facades and step-specific rules callbacks.
events_produced: turn, phase, step, and priority boundaries
subsystem_capsules.privacy_sensitivity: Decision capabilities and private projected alternatives are principal scoped.
subsystem_capsules.removal_condition: No missing-owner condition remains. Compatibility facades may be removed only after historical callers and Game Record v3 replay use the typed ports directly; future work must not restore turn, phase, priority, yield, or decision-capability mutation to engine-local scheduler code.
subsystem_capsules.replay_behavior: Turn, priority, yield, and decision transitions participate in the authoritative command journal and save/load state.
subsystem_capsules.responsibility: Own turn selection, phase and step progression, turn-based actions, priority, yield policy, and player-decision lifecycle.

subsystem_capsules.current_debt: ZoneTransitionOwner owns represented single and simultaneous zone-list mutation, CR 400.7 logical-incarnation reset, timestamp allocation, LKI capture, hidden-zone journaling, and normalized zone-event announcement.
